description: AlphaFold analysis of AMD2 C-terminal accessibility and pLDDT versus peroxisomal PTS1 enzymes MDH3 and SPS19
code:
import requests, re
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def get_af(acc):
    url=f"https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-{acc}-F1-model_v4.pdb"
    r=requests.get(url, timeout=120)
    if r.status_code!=200:
        r=requests.get(f"https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-{acc}-F1-model_v6.pdb", timeout=120)
    return r.status_code, r.text

three2one=dict(ALA='A',ARG='R',ASN='N',ASP='D',CYS='C',GLN='Q',GLU='E',GLY='G',HIS='H',ILE='I',
 LEU='L',LYS='K',MET='M',PHE='F',PRO='P',SER='S',THR='T',TRP='W',TYR='Y',VAL='V')

def parse(pdb):
    res={}; allatoms=[]
    for ln in pdb.splitlines():
        if ln.startswith("ATOM"):
            rn=int(ln[22:26]); an=ln[12:16].strip(); aa=three2one.get(ln[17:20].strip(),'X')
            xyz=np.array([float(ln[30:38]),float(ln[38:46]),float(ln[46:54])])
            b=float(ln[60:66])
            res.setdefault(rn, dict(aa=aa, plddt=b, atoms={}))
            res[rn]["atoms"][an]=xyz
            allatoms.append(xyz)
    return res, np.array(allatoms)

def burial_profile(res, allatoms):
    nums=sorted(res)
    cb=np.array([res[n]["atoms"].get("CB", res[n]["atoms"]["CA"]) for n in nums])
    # neighbour count: heavy atoms within 10 A of CB
    d=np.linalg.norm(allatoms[None,:,:]-cb[:,None,:], axis=2)
    nc=(d<10.0).sum(axis=1)
    return nums, nc

out={}
for gene,acc in [("AMD2","P22580"),("MDH3","P32419"),("SPS19","P32573")]:
    s,pdb=get_af(acc)
    print(gene, acc, "HTTP", s, "bytes", len(pdb))
    if s!=200: continue
    res,aa=parse(pdb)
    nums,nc=burial_profile(res,aa)
    seq="".join(res[n]["aa"] for n in nums)
    pl=np.array([res[n]["plddt"] for n in nums])
    out[gene]=dict(nums=nums,nc=nc,seq=seq,plddt=pl)
    print("  len",len(seq),"Cterm",seq[-8:])
    print("  mean pLDDT overall %.1f | last 10 res %.1f | first 10 res %.1f" % (pl.mean(), pl[-10:].mean(), pl[:10].mean()))
    print("  neighbour count (burial, lower=more exposed): protein median %d | last 3 res %s" %
          (np.median(nc), nc[-3:]))
    print("  burial percentile of last residue: %.1f%%" % (100*(nc<nc[-1]).mean()))

# figure
fig,axes=plt.subplots(2,1,figsize=(11,6.5),sharex=False)
for gene,c in [("AMD2","#d1495b"),("MDH3","#2a7fbf"),("SPS19","#4a9b5c")]:
    if gene not in out: continue
    d=out[gene]; x=np.arange(len(d["seq"]))-len(d["seq"])
    m=x>=-40
    axes[0].plot(x[m], d["plddt"][m], color=c, marker="o", ms=3, label=gene)
    axes[1].plot(x[m], d["nc"][m], color=c, marker="o", ms=3, label=gene)
axes[0].axvspan(-3,0,color="#ffd38a",alpha=.45,zorder=0); axes[0].set_ylabel("pLDDT")
axes[1].axvspan(-3,0,color="#ffd38a",alpha=.45,zorder=0)
axes[1].set_ylabel("heavy atoms within 10 A of CB\n(burial proxy)"); axes[1].set_xlabel("residue position relative to C-terminus (0 = last residue)")
axes[0].set_title("AlphaFold C-terminal region: AMD2 vs two peroxisomal PTS1 enzymes\n(shaded: terminal tripeptide)")
for a in axes:
    a.legend(frameon=False); [a.spines[s].set_visible(False) for s in ("top","right")]
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
